settings.lead_time: Set to order in 28 days, then three days to ship.
settings.reassurance: Free shipping and free resizing, for life. Engraved pieces are final sale.

settings.heading: What happens after you order
settings.text: The stone is chosen the same week and the band is cut to your size. We write once when it goes on the bench and once when it ships.

settings.heading: Changing your mind
settings.text: Within three days, in full, no questions. After that the gold has been cut and the stone is set aside for you.

settings.heading: Engraving
settings.text: Up to three characters on the inside of the band. Engraved pieces are final sale and can be resized one size at most, so tell us the size you are sure of.

settings.heading: If you do not know the size
settings.text: Order anyway and print the sizer. Resizing is free for life, up to three sizes either way, on pieces that are not engraved.

settings.heading: Ordering a piece that does not exist yet
settings.intro: Nothing here is made in advance. That is the whole arrangement, and these are its terms.

settings.heading: The stone is chosen
settings.text: Seen in daylight, against the others from the same parcel. Nothing is ordered from a photograph.

settings.heading: The band is cut to your size
settings.text: Cut, formed and soldered, then left to normalise before anything is set into it.

settings.heading: Set, finished and struck
settings.text: The stone is set flush, the band polished, and the piece number struck last and recorded against your order.
